70:40.text: So I swear by the Lord of all the
points of sunrise and sunset in the east and the west that surely We are Able

70:41.text: better than them; and We are not to be outrun.

70:42.text: So leave them to plunge in vain talk
and play about, until they meet their Day which they are promised -

70:43.text: The Day when they will come out of the graves quickly as racing to a goal,

70:44.text: With their eyes lowered in fear and humility, ignominy covering them
! That is the Day which they were promised!

71:1.text: : "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful torment."

71:2.text: He said: "O my people! Verily, I am a plain warner to you,

71:4.text: will forgive you of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Verily, the term of Allâh when it comes, cannot be delayed, if you but knew."

71:5.text: He said: "O my Lord! Verily, I have called to my people night and day
(i.e. secretly and openly to accept the doctrine of Islâmic Monotheism)

71:6.text: "But all my calling added nothing but to

71:7.text: And verily, every time I called unto them that You might forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, and persisted

71:8.text: "Then verily, I called to them openly

71:9.text: "Then verily, I proclaimed to them in public, and I have appealed to them in private.

71:10.text: : ‘Ask forgiveness from your Lord, verily, He is Oft-Forgiving;
